about: YouTube backing tracks for the Jam Room's list (students can also paste their own link). Add a line per video: title, url (any YouTube link), key (C, G, F#, Bb...), mode (major or minor), optionally start (seconds in, e.g. to skip a solo at the top), and optionally chords (what the video shows, e.g. "C – G – Am – F"). Jamming along with YouTube is ungraded.
